curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the papers and checks before every drive, then define right-of-way and the duty to yield whenever it prevents a crash.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per pre-drive check and right-of-way principle.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on pre-drive steps and the core yielding duty.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through four-way stops, uncontrolled crossroads and T-intersections, roundabouts, blind pedestrians, and the yielding duties for passing, left turns and emergency vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards per yielding rule; contrast cards for arrival order versus the driver on the right and crossroads versus T-intersections.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing an intersection and asking who goes first.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how to count the four-second gap against a fixed object and add a second for each adverse condition.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the count and the added seconds; a contrast card for base count versus additions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing conditions and asking how many seconds to leave.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what a limit means, the default residential, school zone and outlying limits, why the limit is a maximum, and the risks of driving too slowly.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each limit and speed rule; contrast cards for the three default limits and slow versus safe.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a place and asking the default limit.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover on-ramp and off-ramp lanes, who finds the merging gap, stopping distance at speed, the ten-to-fifteen-second look ahead and where to slow down.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for ramps, look-ahead and slow-down places; contrast cards for acceleration versus deceleration lanes and look-ahead versus following gap.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on ramp lanes and how far ahead to look.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define intersections, how to enter them safely, early braking, staying in gear, the sight distance rule, mirror checks, railroad crossings and roadside distraction.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each safe-entry and stopping rule; contrast cards for coasting and the two-part railroad check.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing an approach and asking the safe action.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach space on every side, when to leave more than four seconds ahead, checking behind for tailgaters and handling them, and space for stops and crossings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each space rule; contrast cards for the mirror interval versus the following gap and the tailgater response.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing traffic around you and asking how to manage space.
